pullRequests.title: fix(port): keep white moby glow colours on Vulkan
pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: fix/giant-clank-pad-light
pullRequests.body: mesh.vert decoded a moby's glow word (instance w = 1 + RGB) as int(w - 1.0 + 0.5). For a white glow (0xFFFFFF) w is 2^24, and 2^24 - 1 + 0.5 rounds back up to 2^24 in a float, so the colour became 0x1000000: black. Mesa's GL compiler folds the constants and hides it; the Vulkan path does not, so glow packets in white went dark there, like the lit floor under the Giant Clank pad's grate on Quartu and Veldin. Round w first, then take the 1 off.
